answer_1.quote: Speech-to-text translation (ST) has been traditionally approached with cascade architectures... the decoder has to convert into a text in the target language.

answer_2.quote: Experiments on three language directions (en→de/es/nl) show that the proposed architecture outperforms a state-of-the-art ST model by up to 0.8 BLEU points... Table reports the results computed with SacreBLEU.

answer_4.quote: Lastly, we inspected the baseline and Speechformer outputs to better understand the reason behind the improvements brought by our architecture. This qualitative analysis was conducted on a sample of 200 sentences of the en-de test set by a professional linguist with C2 German level.
answer_4.guideline: Analysis focused on identifying improvements in word ordering, punctuation positioning, audio misunderstandings, and omissions.
